# Packages

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(here)
library(openxlsx)
library(florabr)
library(readxl)
library(reshape)
library(reshape2)
library(tidyverse)
```

# Load data

```{r}
#| message: false
w_matrix <- read_xlsx(here("data/data_ferns.xlsx"), sheet = "w_matrix") |>
  arrange(site) |>
  acast(formula = site ~ taxa, value.var = "FA_New", sum)

# Load reflora data
# flora <- get_florabr(output_dir = "~/Documents/")
flora <- load_florabr(data_dir = "~/Documents/")
```

# Binomials correction

```{r}
# Species from data
spp <- colnames(w_matrix)

# Checking species binomials
a <- check_names(spp, data = flora)
view(a)

# Keep only accepted names
my_spp <- a |> distinct(input_name, .keep_all = T)
my_data <- filter(my_spp, input_name %in% spp)
view(my_data)
```

# Elaborating frequency table

```{r}

d <- apply(w_matrix, 2, FUN = function(x) {
  d <- cbind.data.frame(sum = sum(x), mean = mean(x), nsite = length(x[x > 0]))
  return(d)
})

df_concatenado <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(names(d), function(nome) {
    cbind(input_name = nome, d[[nome]])
  })
)

df_final <- merge(
  cbind(Family = my_data$family, input_name = my_data$input_name),
  df_concatenado,
  by = "input_name"
) |>
  arrange(desc(nsite))

# Singletons
dim(df_final[df_final$nsite == 1, ])
# Doubletons
dim(df_final[df_final$nsite == 2, ])

write.xlsx(df_final, file = here("outputs/summary_freq.xlsx"))
```

# Family Richness

```{r}
df_fam <- group_by(df_final, Family) |>
  summarise(N = n()) |>
  arrange(desc(N)) |>
  mutate(perc = proportions(N) * 100)

head(df_fam)
dim(df_fam)
sum(df_fam$N)

# Plot
ggplot(df_fam, aes(x = reorder(Family, -N), y = N)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", col = "gray70", fill = "#6DF483", alpha = 1) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(colour = "gray10", face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      colour = "black",
      size = 12,
      angle = 90,
      face = "italic"
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = "Family", y = "Richness")

#Save graph
ggsave(
  here("figs/fam_graph.tiff"),
  dpi = 300,
  width = 180,
  height = 100,
  units = "mm"
)
```

# Southern Brazil Terrestrial Ferns Totals

```{r}
view(flora)
br_ferns <- filter(
  flora,
  grepl("Ferns", group) &
    grepl("RS|SC|PR", states) &
    grepl("Accepted", taxonomicStatus) &
    grepl("Species", taxonRank) &
    grepl("Terrestrial", habitat)
)

view(br_ferns)
length(br_ferns$species) #415 terrestrial ferns

## Get family richness at Southern
df_all_ferns <- group_by(br_ferns, family) |>
  summarise(N = n()) |>
  arrange(desc(N)) |>
  mutate(perc = proportions(N) * 100)

head(df_all_ferns)
```
